patch_description: When the search stalls, diversify a rarely used non-elite archive parent with a small, bounded set of multi-switch kicks. Each kick preferentially changes a dual-priced link, but falls back to unrestricted degree-preserving switches when needed. The kicked networks join the ordinary screened neighborhood, with up to two guaranteed evaluation slots so energy ranking cannot discard all of them. This adds a targeted route into less-explored regions without unbounded retries or a large increase in LP usage.
